# E015 -- RAC Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** RAC
- **Industry:** Automotive/Roadside Assistance
- **Year:** 2019
- **Source file:** RAC Brand Guidelines 07.2019.pdf
- **Pages:** ~50+
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Brand promise: "You can trust the RAC for complete peace of mind -- whatever your driving needs" (endorsed by CEO Dave Hobday)
- Core expertise: "experts at everything to do with cars and driving"
- Breakdown at the heart, but expanding to insurance and other driving services
- Customer-insight driven: "What we know about our customers" section
- Positioning: keeping cars -- and lives -- moving

## Logo
- Evolution of logo documented (section 2.1)
- Master logo: full-color primary version
- Reversed white logo: for strong background colors and imagery
- Black print version: for B&W printing
- "The 'a' rule" for clear space: base of the lowercase 'a' (at logo scale) defines isolation area on all four sides
- Minimum sizes: 50px width (digital), 15mm width (print)
- Logo placement on coloured backgrounds and imagery allowed with contrast considerations
- Van branding has dedicated section (2.5)

- Primary typeface (section 5.1)
- Web body typeface (section 5.2) -- separate digital consideration
- Typeface treatment for digital (section 5.3)
- Typeface colour usage for digital (section 5.4)
- Back-up typeface (section 5.5)
- Five sub-sections for typography indicates strong typographic system
- (Specific typeface names not in sampled pages)

- Dual RGB+CMYK specification for both print and digital use

- Dedicated "Voice and tone" section (section 11) with five sub-sections:
  - How we speak and write (11.1)
  - Our voice (11.2)
  - Our tone (11.3)
  - Writing style tips (11.4)
  - "Ones to watch" (11.5)

## Outliers
- "The Chevron" as a hero graphic device with 8 dedicated sub-sections -- major brand asset
- "The 'a' rule" for clear space is an elegant, brand-native measurement system
- RAC Media Garage as an internal asset resource -- shows operational maturity
- Brand architecture section with lock-ups indicates sub-brand/product portfolio management
- Accessibility section under color -- forward-thinking for 2019
- OptinMonster-specific chevron guidance -- very granular digital implementation
- "The tag" in photography -- branded content marker system
- Best practice section (12.0) + "Who to talk to" (13.0) -- shows governance structure
- Van branding section reflects the iconic RAC van fleet as a primary brand touchpoint

## Quality Score
- **Score: 5/5** -- Comprehensive, modern, well-structured brand guide. Exceptional breadth: 13 sections covering brand strategy through best practice and governance. Strong digital-first thinking (separate web typeface, CTA system, digital display specs, accessibility). The Chevron as a distinctive brand device is well-developed. Tone of voice has dedicated depth. Practical touches (Media Garage, "who to talk to") show operational maturity. One of the strongest guides in the collection.
